import json

trace = [
    {
        "step": 1,
        "file": "tests/spng_read_fuzzer.cc",
        "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
        "line": 37,
        "var": "data[1]",
        "code": "int stream = data[1] >> 7;",
        "note": "Attacker controls the high bit of the second byte; when set, streaming mode is enabled, causing ctx->data to be heap-allocated and subject to realloc"
    },
    {
        "step": 2,
        "file": "spng.c",
        "function": "spng_set_png_stream",
        "line": 2382,
        "var": "ctx->data",
        "code": "ctx->data = spng__malloc(ctx, SPNG_READ_SIZE);",
        "note": "In streaming mode ctx->data is heap-allocated with size 8192 (SPNG_READ_SIZE), making it eligible for realloc later"
    },
    {
        "step": 3,
        "file": "spng.c",
        "function": "spng_decoded_image_size",
        "line": 2457,
        "var": "ret",
        "code": "int ret = get_ancillary(ctx);",
        "note": "spng_decoded_image_size calls get_ancillary which triggers parsing of chunks before IDAT"
    },
    {
        "step": 4,
        "file": "spng.c",
        "function": "get_ancillary",
        "line": 1660,
        "var": "ret",
        "code": "ret = read_chunks_before_idat(ctx);",
        "note": "get_ancillary calls read_chunks_before_idat to parse all chunks preceding the IDAT chunk"
    },
    {
        "step": 5,
        "file": "spng.c",
        "function": "read_chunks_before_idat",
        "line": 1050,
        "var": "data",
        "code": "data = ctx->data;",
        "note": "Local pointer 'data' is set to ctx->data before reading chunk bytes; this pointer becomes stale if ctx->data is reallocated"
    },
    {
        "step": 6,
        "file": "spng.c",
        "function": "read_chunks_before_idat",
        "line": 1051,
        "var": "ctx->data",
        "code": "ret = read_chunk_bytes(ctx, chunk.length);",
        "note": "read_chunk_bytes calls read_data which reallocs ctx->data when chunk.length > ctx->data_size (8192) in streaming mode; the old buffer is freed, making 'data' a dangling pointer"
    },
    {
        "step": 7,
        "file": "spng.c",
        "function": "read_data",
        "line": 290,
        "var": "ctx->data",
        "code": "void *buf = spng__realloc(ctx, ctx->data, bytes); ctx->data = buf;",
        "note": "realloc frees the old 8192-byte buffer and allocates a larger one; ctx->data now points to new memory, but local 'data' in read_chunks_before_idat still points to freed memory"
    },
    {
        "step": 8,
        "file": "spng.c",
        "function": "read_chunks_before_idat",
        "line": 1455,
        "var": "data",
        "code": "memcpy(exif.data, data, chunk.length);",
        "note": "Heap-use-after-free READ: memcpy reads chunk.length bytes from the stale 'data' pointer which points to freed heap memory, causing ASAN to report a use-after-free"
    }
]

with open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(trace, f, indent=2)

print("Trace written successfully")
PYEOF
